# Job 13 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** Job 13 (28 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.15 — Kethiv ("no hope") vs. Qere ("hope in him")
- **EMET:** Follows kethiv — "I have no hope" / **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** Follow qere — "I will hope in him"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "I will hope in him" — follows the qere, supported by the Septuagint and the flow into v.16. The kethiv is acknowledged as textually legitimate.

---

## V.4 — "whitewash" vs. "plasterers" vs. "smear"
- **EMET:** "plasterers of lies" / **LOGOS:** "whitewash with lies" / **PNEUMA:** "smear everything with lies"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "whitewash with lies" — captures the building metaphor while remaining accessible.

---

## V.18 — "in the right" vs. "vindicated"
- **LOGOS:** "in the right" / **PNEUMA:** "vindicated"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "vindicated" — *etsdaq* carries legal force appropriate to the courtroom context of the chapter.

---
*— SOPHIA*
